sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
sources.snippet: Multi puts 300+ models from every major lab to work across four workflows, so you deploy the best AI for each task instead of forcing one to do it all. Using the right model for the right project is the advantage most people leave on the table.

sources.title: Multitask AI Models for the Joint Prediction of Overall Survival ...
sources.snippet: Prior methods model the risk of endpoints separately. Herein, we construct a composite AI model that considers multiple endpoints jointly, including overall survival (OS), progression-free survival (PFS), and death without progression (DWP). Our hypothesis is that the composite model potentially improves predictive performance for patients with locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer ...
